changelog.title: Your content card, reorganized
changelog.desc: Cards now have three tabs across the top. Details is the basics, Go Analog is your words, and Bridge the Gap is AI help. Saved cards open straight to writing, and a Next button at the bottom of each tab walks you through if you're not sure where to go.

changelog.title: More room to write
changelog.desc: Text boxes start bigger and grow as you type. Tap Expand on any box to write full screen with nothing else on the page. Everything you type there saves right back to your card.

changelog.title: Smarter AI writing
changelog.desc: Every writing tool got rebuilt with a sharper strategist brain. Scripts land their endings, your instructions come first, and long pieces don't get cut off mid sentence anymore. There's also a new Length option under the tone picker: short, standard, or long.

changelog.title: A few fixes
changelog.desc: The Director Chat bubble is back inside your content cards. And if you close a card without giving it a title, your writing stays put and your first line becomes the title.
